depiction.primary_object: walking stick figure pushing front wheel and handlebars of bicycle

reasoning: The icon depicts a walking figure pushing the front half of a bicycle (handlebars, fork, and front wheel). It fits tasks specifically about walking or wheeling a bike (such as taking a broken bike to a shop, hike-a-bike trail sections, or multimodal transit) and secondarily resembles pushing a lawnmower, though it is easily confused with standard walking or cycling icons at small sizes.
